name: Klaus
description: A two-hundred-year-old Falkenrath vampire who sells false talismans to villagers and is killed by werewolf hunters.

description_citations.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
description_citations.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Klaus, a Falkenrath vampire, runs through the Ulvenwald from a pack of hunters, grinning.
timeline.quote: His feet slap against the brush; blood drips from his slick chin onto the reddening leaves of the Ulvenwald

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: At dusk Klaus drops his glamour and turns into a monstrous form to terrify the hunters.
timeline.quote: Already he can feel it, his body straining beneath the glamour, his teeth growing longer and sharper.

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The hunters shift into towering werewolves in the moonlight.
timeline.quote: their bodies exploding from their fleshy constraints into their real forms: towering beasts

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The werewolf leader tells Klaus the rhyme only applies to humans.

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods

timeline.summary: The werewolves kill Klaus as he leaps from the branch.
